headline: RAM prices skyrocket as AI companies buy up supply
summary: The cost of RAM has quadrupled in 18 months, turning a commodity into a luxury item. AI firms are reportedly buying up future production capacity.
details: RAM prices have seen an unprecedented surge over the past 18 months, with costs expected to continue rising. What was once a consistently affordable component has become a luxury item, impacting the price of new phones, PCs, and tablets.

The dramatic increase is attributed to the massive demand from AI companies. These firms, flush with investor capital, are reportedly purchasing entire years' worth of RAM manufacturing capacity, with some reports claiming that 2027 production is already sold out.

This surge is particularly driven by the demand for High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), a more advanced and faster type of RAM essential for AI training and data centers. Each unit of HBM consumes significantly more wafer supply than standard consumer-grade DRAM.

The impact is stark: a 32GB kit of high-end DDR5-6000 RAM, which cost under $250 at the start of 2025, has now soared to over $1,200. This price hike affects not only PC builders but also the cost of consumer electronics across the board.
